title: Split _transcribe_diarize.py 356 -> 164 + 143 + 105
objective: _transcribe_diarize.py was the last Python file over the 250-line cap. Now that it sits at 100% line and branch coverage, split it three ways along its natural seams: media probing, clustering maths, and the diarization pipeline itself. Code moves verbatim; the tests predate the seam and are re-pointed, not rewritten.
acceptance_criteria: All three resulting modules are under 250 lines; the over-cap total falls 33 -> 32 and no Python file remains over the cap
All 13 top-level definitions are AST-identical to the pre-split file
The same 63 tests pass, with all three modules at 100% line and branch coverage
python3 transcribe_fw.py /nonexistent.wav still exits 2, the code transcribe.sh branches on
Import sites name the owning module - no re-export barrels
out_of_scope: The 29 over-cap shell scripts, which are the remaining work
verifier: A throwaway ast.dump identity check against HEAD; pytest with --cov of all three modules --cov-branch; running transcribe_fw.py and reading $? directly; pre-commit run --files; bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all.
